picks.question: Government shutdown by December 12?
picks.why: A shutdown would delay federal data releases and paychecks, testing fiscal brinkmanship heading into year-end.

picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.2% in November?
picks.why: Labor-market slack is a key signal for whether the Fed keeps easing or holds rates steady.

picks.question: Will real GDP increase by more than 1.5% in Q4 2026?
picks.why: Fourth-quarter growth above 1.5% would show the U.S. economy absorbing elevated inflation and policy uncertainty without stalling.

picks.question: OpenAI IPO closing market cap above $1T?
picks.why: A trillion-dollar debut would show how much public investors will pay for AI, shaping capital flows across tech.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2026?
picks.why: AI-generated proofs of major open problems would mark a leap in machine reasoning, with implications for research productivity.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which lab leads frontier AI shapes competition, cloud spending, and where the technology's productivity gains accrue.
